races.paceDynamic: Thistle Cross will take them along as the sole confirmed front runner but given his fade-in-finish tendency and modest ability, he's unlikely to sustain serious pressure. The prominent runners Suspicious Mindz, Sunrush and Full Moon Tonight will track closely behind with a large pack of hold-up horses including Trustmore, Coasting and Matilda Joslyngage waiting to pounce. With 15 runners and only one genuine leader, this sets up a steady tempo early before accelerating from halfway. This tactical setup strongly favours the hold-up merchants and closers who can capitalize on the modest early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Thistle Cross sets his usual honest but unspectacular gallop and the prominent runners don't apply early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace becomes pedestrian through the first half-mile, allowing the better-class hold-up horses to unleash devastating finishing kicks. Trustmore, Matilda Joslyngage and the O'Brien newcomers benefit most from this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Suspicious Mindz or Full Moon Tonight press forward to challenge Thistle Cross early and maintain the tempo
scenarios.body: The race develops into a more honest gallop that prevents the back markers from winding up their runs effectively. Suspicious Mindz's consistent form gives him the edge in a more truly-run affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Thistle Cross fades dramatically turning in and no prominent runner takes up the running
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint with horses coming from all angles in the final furlong. The most progressive types with natural speed benefit from the chaotic finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Shocks
scenarios.trigger: If Thistle Cross finds improved form after his break and the field allows him too much rope
scenarios.body: His early lead becomes unassailable as the chasing pack leaves their runs too late on the good ground. Only a dramatic improvement in form makes this viable given his poor recent efforts.

Watch for Trustmore's headgear impact as the previous promise could be unlocked with the pace-setter addition
Observe if Thistle Cross shows more early speed than usual as this could disrupt the expected pace scenario

races.paceDynamic: Faoladh is the lone confirmed front-runner and will dictate from the gates, with Dynamic Force, Ohmali and Proleek Prince the only other prominent runners in this 17-horse field. With such a small pace contingent, Faoladh can roll along comfortably without serious pressure, creating a sustainable tempo that may not truly test stamina. The majority hold-up horses will need to rely on tactical speed rather than grinding power. This race shape clearly favours horses with tactical pace who can position handily rather than true hold-up horses who need a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Faoladh gets an easy lead and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The front-runner can dictate ideal fractions and kick clear when the field closes, while hold-up horses struggle with insufficient pace to aim at. Horses like Land Of The Giants and Lough Leane who can track closer benefit most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Dynamic Force or Ohmali inject pace from the 4f pole to pressure Faoladh
scenarios.body: This creates the stronger gallop that hold-up horses need, allowing closers with tactical speed to time their runs perfectly. Bay Of Dreams and Monvoe can exploit the increased tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Faoladh goes too fast early trying to shake off trackers
scenarios.body: The leader ties up in the final furlong, creating a sprint finish that suits horses held up with finishing kicks. Bucaneer's Spirit and Perfect Judgement can capitalise despite the weak pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners successfully stalks and outkicks Faoladh
scenarios.body: Dynamic Force or Ohmali get the perfect trip tracking the leader and have enough left to forge clear. The hold-up division remains too far back to impact.

races.paceDynamic: Timeless Charm and Diamond Exchange will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front runners likely to set a solid gallop over this extended trip. Great Mover and Chica Guerrera should track prominently behind the leaders, while the majority of the field including Summer Snow, Star Mind, and Tatum will settle back and look to come with late runs. The honest early pace set by two natural leaders should create ideal conditions for the hold-up horses to unleash sustained finishes. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up performers who can capitalise on the likely strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves testing with Timeless Charm and Diamond Exchange going hard early
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will set up perfect conditions for the back-markers to sweep past tiring leaders in the final furlong. Summer Snow and Star Mind are best positioned to exploit this scenario with their proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Great Mover and Chica Guerrera can secure ideal tracking positions behind the leaders
scenarios.body: They'll have the tactical advantage of avoiding both the early burn-up and the traffic problems that could hinder the hold-up horses. Great Mover's recent consistent form makes him the prime beneficiary of this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an easier time than expected with the other folding early
scenarios.body: Diamond Exchange's recent winning form suggests she could sustain a bold show throughout if getting loose on the lead. Her proven stamina at this trip makes her the most likely to resist late challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits All
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners come back to the field creating a messy, slowly-run affair
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where ratings and recent form become paramount over running styles. This scenario would favour the highest-rated horses regardless of their preferred tactics.

races.paceDynamic: Scandinavia, Dallas Star and Mont St Michel will ensure a strong gallop from the outset over this stamina-sapping 1m6f trip. With three confirmed front runners in a small field, the pace will be genuine throughout, testing stamina reserves to the maximum. The relentless gallop will set up the race for horses that can stay and finish strongly from off the pace. This race shape heavily favours hold-up horses and closers who can capitalise on the inevitable pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners go too fast early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The strong pace will set up perfectly for Le Destrier and Leinster to sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. Both hold-up specialists will have maximum opportunity to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If Scandinavia can get first run on his rivals and kick clear
scenarios.body: His superior class (OR 117) and recent winning form gives him the best chance to withstand the pressure and maintain his advantage. Ryan Moore's tactical brilliance could prove decisive in managing the pace battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Dallas Star and Mont St Michel don't show their usual early speed
scenarios.body: The pace could become more tactical, allowing prominent runners like Happy Pharoah to get into contention earlier. This would neutralise the hold-up horses' advantage and create a more open finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If Dallas Star or Mont St Michel get an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: One of the outsider front runners could steal a march if the others don't engage early enough. However, their inferior class ratings make this the least likely outcome against this field.

races.paceDynamic: Numidia stands as the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the outset with Eastern Wind and Marians Gal providing the only prominent support. This setup creates a controlled tempo with minimal early pressure, allowing Numidia to bowl along at a sustainable gallop through the early and middle stages. The large field of 20 runners means the hold-up brigade including Trishuli River, Maxwell Smart, and Amavasya will be bunched towards the rear, relying on late finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those who can track the pace closely, as the lack of early speed pressure will leave too much to do for the pure hold-up merchants.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Numidia maintains an uncontested lead through reasonable fractions
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to kick clear turning for home while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back. Prominent runners tracking the pace get first run on the weakening leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If Eastern Wind or Marians Gal sit perfectly behind Numidia's moderate gallop
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the ideal trip tracking a steady pace before swooping past the tiring leader in the final furlong. They have enough left to hold off the late closers who leave their runs too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too slow and sets up a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed creates a bunched field turning for home, allowing the best finishers with tactical speed to unleash decisive late kicks. Quality hold-up horses with recent form strike gold.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Numidia folds early leaving no pace in the race
scenarios.body: The contest becomes a messy tactical affair with no clear tempo, suiting horses who can quicken from any position rather than pure front-runners or hold-up specialists.

races.paceDynamic: Poetic Sound and Touch The Moon will contest the early lead with Soaring Sun, Autumn Twist and Nakasero sitting prominently behind. This creates a genuine pace with multiple front-runners ensuring no dawdling early fractions. The sustained gallop over 1m4f will stretch the field and test stamina reserves in the final three furlongs. This pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses who can conserve energy and finish fastest when the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too fast early creating a strong gallop
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find out the front-runners in the final furlong as they tire from their exertions. Late-running horses like Star Harbour, Jabbar and Drucker can pick up the pieces with their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Poetic Sound Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Sound gets an uncontested lead and slows the pace significantly
scenarios.body: The front-runner can conserve energy early and has enough left to resist late challengers over this stamina test. The 206-day break becomes less relevant if the pace is steady throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Drucker Form Continuation
scenarios.trigger: If the recent Stayers' Hurdles form translates directly to this handicap contest
scenarios.body: The improving four-year-old can overcome the style bias with superior current form and fitness levels. His recent win at this trip gives him a significant confidence boost over these older rivals.
